task_description: SQL migration Phase 4: consolidate the two PresenterSettings JSON writers into one PresenterSettingsService, then back both SettingsService (AppSettings) and PresenterSettingsService (PresenterSettings) with the shared SQLite app.db via the Phase-0 AppDatabase helper. Single-row (Id=1, DataJson TEXT) table per store, defensive one-time JSON import, enums-as-strings parity, public API preserved. Scope strictly to the two settings stores, their construction sites (MainWindow + PresenterIntegration), and their tests. Do NOT touch service-orders or songs.
